slots.label: Heading 1
slots.default: Strategy is a habit, not a document

slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: A plan written once and filed is worth very little. Businesses change, budgets move, a client asks for something new, and a roadmap drifts out of date within a couple of quarters if nobody revisits it.

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: Quarterly or half-yearly suits most businesses we work with: what did we plan, what actually happened, what changed in the business, what moves up the list. It usually takes an hour and it stops the plan quietly becoming fiction.

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: A technology audit or IT health check gives the roadmap something factual to stand on rather than assumptions about what is installed and how old it is. If you have never had that done, it is the sensible starting point.
